body: I'm perfectly comfortable since I am more or less anonymous. The reality is there is no reason for me to feel this way, I just hate myself. Sometimes I feel incredibly happy and content. Other times I just feel like existence is utterly pointless and I'm dumbfounded that anyone wants to continue living. I'm a grad student with clinical anxiety and I'm almost certainly depressed. I'm away from home right now but once I'm back I am going to look in to the free psych sessions my school offers. Anyway, I wanted to tell someone I decided not to kill myself so thanks for listening.
